name: @pipeworx/mcp-ssb-no

tools.name: subjects
tools.description: Navigate the subject tree. Pass a node id path under /table/ (default empty = root list of subjects). Each level returns child nodes ({id, type, text}); type "l" is a folder, "t" is a leaf table whose id is the numeric table id used by table_meta/query_table. e.g. path "" -> subjects, "be" -> Population, "be05" -> Population count tables.

path.description: Sub-path under /table/ (default empty = root). e.g. "be" or "be05".

tools.name: table_meta
tools.description: Table definition (variables/dimensions and valid values). id is the numeric SSB table id, e.g. "07459".

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Pull data from a table. id is the numeric SSB table id; body is a PxWeb query object. Omitted dimensions with elimination collapse; otherwise select values per dimension.

tools.name: ssb_no_classification
tools.description: Look up a Statistics Norway (SSB) KLASS classification (code list) and its correspondences, valid at a date or year. Answers e.g. "which KOSTRA group is Bergen in, 2025?" (id 112 = KOSTRA municipality groups, mapped to id 131 = municipalities by default) and lists all municipalities in a county (code_prefix "46" = Vestland) with their KOSTRA group for each of several years. Other ids: 131 municipalities, 104 counties. Without id lists classifications. Unknown id returns found:false. Source: Statistics Norway (SSB), KLASS classification service.

id.description: KLASS classification id, e.g. 112 (KOSTRA groups), 131 (municipalities). Omit to list classifications.

year.description: Year; resolves to 1 January of that year. Default: today.

years.description: Several years in one call (max 10), e.g. [2023,2024,2025].

target_id.description: Target classification for correspondences (default 131 when id is 112). Omit for a plain code list.

code.description: Match one code on either side, e.g. "4601" (Bergen) or "EKG12".

code_prefix.description: Match codes starting with this on either side, e.g. "46" for Vestland municipalities.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ssb-no forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ssb-no pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
